# gpui-ai component index

<!-- Generated by gallery-catalog-export from crates/gallery/src/story.rs. Do not edit. -->

Generated from the gpui-ai 0.8.0 checkout. Resolve the consuming application's exact gpui-ai version before relying on a constructor: this index describes the checkout that contains it, while an application may be pinned elsewhere.

Every component renders a snapshot supplied by the application and leaves durable work, state transitions, and clocks with the application. Read `../state-events-and-progress.md` for the ownership pattern and `../component-selection.md` for composition judgment.
